name: The Age of Vampires
source:
Fifty years ago, human politicians made a secret pact with the vampire enclave. The first vampire, Lester, left the humans alone in exchange for blood supplies and the ability to conduct his business. The president was given control of parliament and the ability to manufacture lethal weapons to increase his influence in the world. 

But the humans' plan got out of hand. The vampires took the upper hand and took over the city. A hunt for the president began. Urgent testing of a poison that sends vampire blood when bitten began. This poison was supposed to save the president, but he never waited for the final vaccine.

[From [url=https://enotpoloskun.itch.io/the-age-of-vampire]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
50年前，人類政客與吸血鬼群體達成了秘密協議。最初的吸血鬼萊斯特不再侵擾人類，換取血液供應與開展自身事業的自由。總統則獲得對議會的控制權，以及製造致命武器的能力，以擴大自己在世界上的影響力。

然而，人類的計畫失控了。吸血鬼佔據上風，奪取城市，並開始追捕總統。人們緊急測試一種毒劑，希望在遭到咬噬時讓毒素進入吸血鬼的血液。這本該救下總統，可他終究沒能等到最終的疫苗完成。

[摘自[url=https://enotpoloskun.itch.io/the-age-of-vampire]itch.io[/url]]
